question: Sabine: seconds = 0.161 × volume ÷ absorption. A 20,000 m³ hall has 1,610 m² of absorption; an audience adds 690 more. Seconds when full?
move: Count the people as part of the room they fill.
trap: Working out the empty hall and forgetting the audience soaks up sound.
hint: Add the audience to the absorption before dividing.
source: Beranek, Concert Halls and Opera Houses, 2004
reference: Beranek, Concert Halls and Opera Houses: Music, Acoustics, and Architecture, 2nd edition, Springer, 2004
